messages:
maya: Quick thread — drafting a hybrid realtime sampling checklist for onboarding the new 13B-hybrid model with speculative decoding.

oliver: Nice. Goal: ~2x p50 speedup, <=1% relative quality drop on our rerank/QA evals. Right?

maya: Correct. Also want to test interaction with 4-bit quant and our KV prefetch. Suggested ablations:
- speculative window sizes: 8, 16, 32
- fallback policy: immediate vs delayed
- partial-kv prefetch: off/on
- beam vs topk sampling

sasha: Add metric list: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, mean time-to-first-token (TTFT), perplexity on longtail eval, pass@1 on code tasks, and helpfulness/regression on our 1k curated eval set.

jun: Quick harness commands: 
```
python eval/run.py --model redwood/13b-hybrid --quant 4 --spec_window 16 --fallback delayed --seed 42 --out /tmp/spec-16.json
```
and then run `tools/compare_eval.py /baseline.json /tmp/spec-16.json` for diffed metrics.

ci-bot: nightly-run finished for spec_window=16. Results: p50 68ms -> 39ms (1.74x), p95 210ms -> 170ms (1.24x). MMLU acc 77.2 -> 76.6 (-0.6), TruthfulQA slight dip, and hallucination footprint increased: 12/1000 failing samples flagged.

oliver: Hmm hallucination bump — can we trace to greedy fallback? sample ID 42 shows truncated prefix when fallback triggers during token 3.

maya: Action items:
1) Sweep spec_window = [8,16,32] across quant={4,8} and measure both latency + quality (owner: sasha)
2) Instrument fallback traces + dump KV-state on fallback samples (owner: jun)
3) Run a 200-sample human evaluation for helpfulness/regressions (owner: oliver)
4) Temporary mitigation: enable conservative fallback for prompts <256 tokens to avoid early truncation

sasha: I'll schedule the matrix jobs this afternoon and post CI links. Will add a column for token-level blame (where fallback occurs).

maya: Thanks — will sync after the CI matrix is in. :thumbsup:
